title: Wave with a kept span

techniques.name: Dot record

dot.label: Dot size
dot.note: Radius of every dot, as a multiple of the page’s own.

density.label: Density
density.note: Dots per cluster: more dots carry the same count at a finer grain; fewer leave it sparse.

spread.label: Spread
spread.note: How wide each cluster of dots is laid around its point.

scatter.label: Scatter
scatter.note: How far each dot is knocked off its well-spaced place, in dot radii. 0 is the page’s even stipple.

techniques.implementation: Every character of a record is one dot; position comes from the model, tone from who wrote it. Drawn by the source page’s own code, with its helpers given dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.
